assumptions.statement: The overall and three key-area polygons are provisional constraints supplied by the repository, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All design cells, area metrics, figures, HTML and PDFs are temporary concept outputs and must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Release of official machine-readable polygons with CRS and provenance.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setback, road-redline and parcel controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: No statutory development intensity or final building scale is claimed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Approved regulatory plan and competent-authority confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Precise heritage inventory, protection zones, archaeological conditions and approved interpretation material are absent.
assumptions.impact: The Main Text is a concept public framework, not the railway, a heritage boundary or a construction line.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Heritage survey, approved protection documents and curator review.

assumptions.statement: Current building footprints, structure, ownership, vacancy, fire conditions and embodied-carbon baselines are absent.
assumptions.impact: Building polygons are lightweight concept carriers only; retain/renovate/demolish decisions remain unknown.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Measured survey, ownership check, structural/fire review and lifecycle assessment.

assumptions.statement: Traffic flows, station interfaces, road rights-of-way, crossings, accessible-route continuity and parking demand are absent.
assumptions.impact: The eight Marginalia links express required relationships, not approved streets or bridges.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Day/night mobility counts, accessibility walks, station coordination and traffic engineering.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, energy, communications, fire and emergency capacities are absent.
assumptions.impact: No capacity, resilience or infrastructure-sizing claim is made.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Official utility conditions, topography, drainage model and emergency review.

assumptions.statement: No local asset, oral-history, model, dataset, image, voice or consent inventory has been collected for this concept package.
assumptions.impact: Scenarios use synthetic or cleared test material only; no resident contribution is presumed available.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Voluntary, item-level rights and consent process with correction and withdrawal channels.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, revenue-sharing, compensation, service levels and long-term custodians are not appointed.
assumptions.impact: The operating calendar and responsibility roles are design hypotheses, not government or partner commitments.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Public-interest governance, procurement, legal, finance and community agreement.

assumptions.statement: Content-credential persistence, withdrawal propagation and multilingual comprehension have not been tested on site.
assumptions.impact: The three industry tests are research protocols; no performance result is claimed.
assumptions.resolution_trigger: Reproducible lab and public-comprehension results with independent review.
